about: The source model of an OME-Zarr 0.4 hierarchy on Zarr v2 storage (spec/virtualize/ome-zarr.md, spec/virtualize.md §11 <https://github.com/d-v-b/refkv/blob/main/spec/virtualize/ome-zarr.md#11-ome-zarr-profile>): the elements of its store IR, and the roles an OME group, a multiscale, a dataset, a label image, a plate, a well and a collection play, each with the constraints of spec/virtualize/ome-zarr.md §4 <https://github.com/d-v-b/refkv/blob/main/spec/virtualize/ome-zarr.md#4-validation> a store must meet to have the OME-Zarr convention's layout. The Zarr v2 store format (src/zarr2.rs, schema/zarr2.json) reads the listing and the node documents and applies the Zarr v2 convention's rules (spec/virtualize/zarr2.md §2 <https://github.com/d-v-b/refkv/blob/main/spec/virtualize/zarr2.md#2-nodes>–§5 <https://github.com/d-v-b/refkv/blob/main/spec/virtualize/zarr2.md#5-other-objects>); for a store whose root declares OME-NGFF 0.4, its OME layer (src/ome_zarr.rs) decides which role each group and value plays, in the order the profile does, and checks this schema there; the projection reads a valid IR and checks nothing.

axis_orders.about: the axis kinds an multiscale may have, in order (I3): t a time axis, o another (channel, custom or no type), s a space axis

elements.about: The store IR is the Zarr v2 format's (schema/zarr2.json, spec/virtualize/zarr2.md §4.1 <https://github.com/d-v-b/refkv/blob/main/spec/virtualize/zarr2.md#41-elements>): the OME layer adds no element.

about_builtins: What the parser's code computes and the roles above check: the store's nodes from its listing and their documents (spec/virtualize/zarr2.md §2 <https://github.com/d-v-b/refkv/blob/main/spec/virtualize/zarr2.md#2-nodes>–§4 <https://github.com/d-v-b/refkv/blob/main/spec/virtualize/zarr2.md#4-source-metadata>, whose rejections are the code's), the JSON types of each value a role reads, relative paths and their resolution against a group (L6), the declaration of OME-NGFF 0.4 at the root (spec/virtualize.md §1.4 <https://github.com/d-v-b/refkv/blob/main/spec/virtualize.md#14-store-inputs>), and the dropped datasets of label images (L7).
